pull_request_backfill.method: Applied PR heads or exact stable patch IDs, author emails and author timestamps; every non-merge PR commit absent from main must match, and ambiguous heads or heads explicitly attributed to other PRs are excluded.
pull_request_backfill.limitations: Unmatched or manually edited patches remain unknown, not rejected PRs.

maintainer_history.definition: Before the 2014 README roster: non-bot first-parent committers whose mailmapped email differs from the author, deduplicated by connected case-insensitive committer names and emails. The 2014 cross-check gives six, matching its README.

historical_backfill.method: One-off extraction of formula URL, version, revision and rebuild declarations before evaluation with FormulaVersions. Install, dependency and compiler-requirement DSL omitted; unused assignments removed. Historical bottle revision/version declarations normalised to rebuild. The 2015 URL version parser supplies versions no longer detected by the current reader. A final metadata pass strips malformed descriptions and URL whitespace, preserves literal plus signs, reads explicit custom Version values and pinned VCS revisions, and selects the highest declared compiler-dependent gfortran version.

empty_formula_removal.definition: Intentional migration to the head-only tap emptied the formula before the next commit removed the file. No version or update is inferred; this empty file is excluded from unreadable metadata.
